planets.name: K2-21 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-21 with a 15.5-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: K2-21 c was found in 2015 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-21. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DRESSING_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2015, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 15.50195, pl_radj 0.22214292, pl_bmassj 0.0213

quotes.title: K2-21
quotes.card: The inner planet, K2-21b, is less dense than the outer planet, K2-21c.
